description_en: Queries the logs of a Logstash instance
kebab_example: aliyun elasticsearch list-logstash-log --instance-id ls-cn-v0h1kzca0000 --type LOGSTASH_INSTANCE_LOG --query host:10.7.xx.xx_AND_level:info_AND_content:opening --api-version 2017-06-13 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListLogstashLog

parameters.help_en:
The log type. Valid values:

LOGSTASH_INSTANCE_LOG: main log.
SEARCHSLOW: searching slow log.
INDEXINGSLOW: indexing slow log.
JVMLOG: GC log.
LOGSTASH_DEBUG_LOG: debug log
parameters.help_zh:
日志类型。可选值：

LOGSTASH_INSTANCE_LOG：主日志。
SEARCHSLOW：searching慢日志。
INDEXINGSLOW：indexing慢日志。
JVMLOG：GC日志。
LOGSTASH_DEBUG_LOG：调试日志
parameters.name: type

parameters.help_en: The beginning of the time range to query logs. This value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: milliseconds
parameters.help_zh: 日志开始的时间戳。单位：毫秒
parameters.name: begin_time

parameters.help_en: The end of the time range to query logs. This value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: milliseconds
parameters.help_zh: 日志结束的时间戳。单位：毫秒
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: The page number of the instance list. Default value: 1. Minimum value: 1. Maximum value: 200
parameters.help_zh: 实例列表的页码。默认值：1，最小值：1，最大值：200
parameters.name: page

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page for the paged query. Default value: 20. Minimum value: 1. Maximum value: 100
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时设置的每页条数。默认值：20，最小值：1，最大值：100
parameters.name: size

content.description_en: The detailed content of the log

host.description_en: The IP address of the node that generated the log
host.description_zh: 生成日志的节点的IP地址

level.description_en: The log level. Valid values include trace, debug, info, warn, and error. GC logs do not have a level
level.description_zh: 日志级别。包括trace、debug、info、warn、error等内容（GC日志没有level）

timestamp.description_en: The timestamp when the log was generated. Unit: milliseconds
timestamp.description_zh: 日志生成的时间戳。单位：毫秒
